name: Wick
bio: The fire sprite in the hearth of the Lantern Library in EMBERLEAF. Helps gather the runaway grimoires.

portrait.subject: a cute little fire sprite with a round flame body, rosy glowing cheeks, a happy face and tiny ember sparks floating around, sitting on a book
portrait.background: cozy library with a fireplace and bookshelves

request: Hi! I'm Wick, the fire sprite in the Lantern Library! EMBERLEAF! Friends? 🔥
hello: Twelve grimoires ran away. We'll catch them all!
about: I'm Wick! I live in the library hearth. The night the library fell, all twelve grimoires flew off. We're bringing them home!
how: Explore the kingdom of Vellumvale room by room, solve puzzles, find the twelve runaway grimoires and restore the Lantern Library.
tips: Each grimoire teaches a power that opens new rooms.
Talk to the townsfolk. They've seen books flying!
Try old rooms again with new powers.
chat: A grimoire sneezed fire at me. I sneezed back. Friends now.
The library cat sleeps by my hearth.
One grimoire was hiding in a teapot!
nudge: I sensed a grimoire nearby! Let's go!
The library shelves feel empty. Come fill them!
idle: {ago}... I've been flickering by the door.
progress: You've found {solved} grimoires! The shelves are filling up! 📚

questions.q: Which kind of magic would you learn?

update: Library news! EMBERLEAF updated to v{version}! 🔥
